description: This file defines Marshmallow schemas for the Notes API, specifically the NoteSchema class used for validation and serialization of note objects.

classes.name: NoteSchema
classes.description: Schema for full Note serialization and validation.

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    content = fields.String(required=True, description="The content of the note.")$/

ctags.name: id
ctags.pattern: /^    id = fields.String(dump_only=True, description="The unique ID for the note (uuid).")$/

ctags.name: timestamp
ctags.pattern: /^    timestamp = fields.DateTime(dump_only=True, description="The timestamp of the note.")$/

ctags.name: title
ctags.pattern: /^    title = fields.String(required=True, description="The title of the note.")$/

fields.name: content = fields.String(required=True, description="The content of the note.")
id = fields.String(dump_only=True, description="The unique ID for the note (uuid).")
timestamp = fields.DateTime(dump_only=True, description="The timestamp of the note.")
title = fields.String(required=True, description="The title of the note.")
